thirteenFetchForm.candidateSlots: Retained slot11 is2048*2048 format18; slot12 is4096*4096 format18. These make them blend/lightmap candidates only. No retained record joins terrain+0xD4 to11 or terrain+0xD8 to12. Slots8..10 are512*512 format18; slot7 is1024*1024 format6. Dimensions do not name materials.
thirteenFetchForm.coordinates: Pixel slots11 and12 both sample TEXCOORD3.xy with normalized2D coordinates and zero explicit fetch offset. In the retained paired vertex translation, q is the decoded TEXCOORD0 input after its configured integer/float conversion. The common coordinate is u=clamp(q.x+c16.x,0,32768)/32768, v=1-clamp(q.y+c16.y,0,32768)/32768. The numerical clamp/scale comes from the retained vertex literals; c16 and the q-to-native/world join are not established. This proves no relative vertical flip in the shader between these slots, conditional on their role identity. It supplies no absolute native-map or file-row mapping, texel-centre rule or final filtered edge result.
thirteenFetchForm.guestSampler: The retained slot11/12 fetch fields decode as unsigned signs, RGBA fetch swizzle, repeat addressing, linear magnification/minification/mip filtering, disabled anisotropy, mip0..0 and zero LOD bias. The pixel fetches at microcode offsets84 and144 use the fetch-constant filters, computed LOD, no register LOD/gradients, and zero X/Y/Z offsets. Final host binding overrides/component mapping remain separate.
thirteenFetchForm.componentUse: Slot11 logical fetched x drives interpolation toward slot8, y toward slot9, and z toward slot10, in that order. Intermediate color swizzles are explicit; the third result is saturated. These are successive interpolations, not an unordered normalized three-material sum. Slots11/12 use only fetched xyz in this selected pixel program; their sampled alpha is not the output-alpha source.
thirteenFetchForm.materialMeaning: Which concrete textures/materials occupy8/9/10, their relation to raw DDS R/G/B, and whether bindings depend on climate/era remain unbound. Owner-observed red/green effects do not establish a universal material table.
thirteenFetchForm.candidateLighting: Let L be slot12 logical fetched xyz, C the blended color, a=c255.x, b=c255.y and t=c255.z. The program compares L.x with t. In the L.x>=t arm it adds a before multiplying C; in the other arm it scales L by b before multiplying C, with the stated swizzle ordering. Slot7 then multiplies that result. Subsequent inverse-square-root/product and constant/interpolant color mixing remain part of the output path. Thus neither a universally straight lightmap multiply, a fixed overbright factor, nor white neutrality follows without the role and effective-constant joins. The program has a multiplicative intermediate, not a complete lightmap-color-space contract.

eightFetchForm.contract: Only slots0..7 are sampled. The selected program combines squared/swizzled sources0..3 using logical scalar components from4..6, then multiplies by slot7 and applies a later color term. It has no slot11/12 fetch and no2048/4096 candidate in its retained metadata. Do not merge this program's texture/lighting contract with the thirteen-fetch form.
